description: AIRP Engine Surface SSE transport contract. Event data is the JSON serialization of the corresponding airp_state_protocol Surface v2 message.

eventId.resumeRule: Send the last successfully applied event id verbatim as Last-Event-ID. Clients must not parse or synthesize cursors.

extensionRules: eventNames is closed for version 1; clients must not reinterpret unknown event names as snapshots or patches.
Event data inherits the opaque-additive unknown-field policy of surface-protocol-v2.json.
The SSE event name and data.kind discriminator must match.
A client must apply an event id only after its JSON data has been validated and applied successfully.
